"""Investigation report generation.

The report is assembled from stored facts.  Every section names the evidence it
came from, so a reader can click a claim and land on the bytes that support it.
A language model, when one is enabled, may only add a clearly-labelled
narrative paragraph to a report that already exists without it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Sequence

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..core.config import Limits
from ..core.logging import get_logger
from ..models import (
    Capture,
    Evidence,
    ExperimentEvent,
    Hypothesis,
    Interpretation,
    Message,
    Packet,
    Project,
    Report,
    Stream,
    TcpSession,
    ValidationResult,
    ValidationRun,
)
from ..interpretation.engine import parse_spec

log = get_logger("mplab.report")

REPORT_VERSION = "report/1.1"


@dataclass
class Section:
    number: int
    title: str
    body: str
    evidence: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "number": self.number,
            "title": self.title,
            "body": self.body,
            "evidence": self.evidence,
            "notes": self.notes,
        }


@dataclass
class ReportContext:
    project: Project
    captures: list[Capture]
    sessions: list[TcpSession]
    streams: list[Stream]
    messages: list[Message]
    hypotheses: list[Hypothesis]
    interpretations: list[Interpretation]
    runs: list[ValidationRun]
    experiments: list[ExperimentEvent]
    counterexamples: list[ValidationResult]
    integrity: dict[str, Any]


def collect_context(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    *,
    capture_ids: Sequence[str] = (),
    interpretation_ids: Sequence[str] = (),
    storage=None,
    limits: Limits | None = None,
) -> ReportContext:
    captures = list(
        session.execute(
            select(Capture).where(
                Capture.project_id == project.id,
                *([Capture.id.in_(list(capture_ids))] if capture_ids else []),
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    ids = [c.id for c in captures]
    sessions = (
        list(
            session.execute(select(TcpSession).where(TcpSession.capture_id.in_(ids)))
            .scalars()
            .all()
        )
        if ids
        else []
    )
    streams = (
        list(
            session.execute(
                select(Stream).where(Stream.session_id.in_([s.id for s in sessions]))
            )
            .scalars()
            .all()
        )
        if sessions
        else []
    )
    messages = (
        list(
            session.execute(
                select(Message)
                .where(Message.capture_id.in_(ids))
                .order_by(Message.capture_id, Message.stream_id, Message.index_in_stream)
                .limit(50_000)
            )
            .scalars()
            .all()
        )
        if ids
        else []
    )
    hypotheses = list(
        session.execute(
            select(Hypothesis).where(Hypothesis.project_id == project.id)
        ).scalars().all()
    )
    interpretations = list(
        session.execute(
            select(Interpretation)
            .where(
                Interpretation.project_id == project.id,
                *([Interpretation.id.in_(list(interpretation_ids))] if interpretation_ids else []),
            )
            .order_by(Interpretation.created_at)
        ).scalars().all()
    )
    runs = list(
        session.execute(
            select(ValidationRun)
            .where(ValidationRun.interpretation_id.in_([i.id for i in interpretations]))
            .order_by(ValidationRun.started_at)
        ).scalars().all()
        if interpretations
        else []
    )
    experiments = list(
        session.execute(
            select(ExperimentEvent)
            .where(ExperimentEvent.project_id == project.id)
            .order_by(ExperimentEvent.timestamp)
            .limit(5_000)
        ).scalars().all()
    )
    counterexamples = (
        list(
            session.execute(
                select(ValidationResult)
                .where(
                    ValidationResult.validation_run_id.in_([r.id for r in runs]),
                    ValidationResult.outcome == "failed",
                )
                .limit(500)
            ).scalars().all()
        )
        if runs
        else []
    )
    integrity: dict[str, Any] = {"all_match": None, "captures": [], "note": "Integrity was not verified during this run."}
    if storage is not None:
        from ..services.project_service import ProjectService

        integrity = ProjectService(session, storage, limits).verify_integrity(project)
    return ReportContext(
        project=project,
        captures=captures,
        sessions=sessions,
        streams=streams,
        messages=messages,
        hypotheses=hypotheses,
        interpretations=interpretations,
        runs=runs,
        experiments=experiments,
        counterexamples=counterexamples,
        integrity=integrity,
    )


def build_sections(ctx: ReportContext) -> list[Section]:
    sections: list[Section] = []

    sections.append(
        Section(
            1,
            "Project",
            f"**{ctx.project.name}**\n\n{ctx.project.description or '_No description recorded._'}",
            evidence=[{"kind": "project", "id": ctx.project.id}],
        )
    )

    capture_lines = []
    capture_evidence = []
    for capture in ctx.captures:
        status = capture.analysis_status
        capture_lines.append(
            f"- `{capture.name}` - format {capture.format}, {capture.file_size} bytes, "
            f"SHA-256 `{capture.sha256}`, analysis: {status}"
        )
        capture_evidence.append(
            {"kind": "capture", "id": capture.id, "sha256": capture.sha256}
        )
    sections.append(
        Section(
            2,
            "Source captures",
            "\n".join(capture_lines) if capture_lines else "_No captures imported._",
            evidence=capture_evidence,
            notes=[
                "SHA-256 lets a reader confirm they hold the same bytes; it does not "
                "prove where the file came from."
            ],
        )
    )

    experiment_lines = [
        f"- {datetime.fromtimestamp(e.timestamp, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat()} "
        f"{e.action} {json.dumps(e.parameters, ensure_ascii=False)}"
        for e in ctx.experiments[:200]
    ]
    sections.append(
        Section(
            3,
            "Experiment conditions",
            "\n".join(experiment_lines) if experiment_lines else "_No experiment log imported._",
            evidence=[{"kind": "experiment", "id": e.id} for e in ctx.experiments[:50]],
        )
    )

    corpus = {
        "packets": len(ctx.messages) and sum(
            1 for _ in ctx.messages
        ),  # placeholder replaced below
        "tcp_sessions": len(ctx.sessions),
        "streams": len(ctx.streams),
        "messages": len(ctx.messages),
    }
    corpus["messages"] = len(ctx.messages)
    corpus["bytes_in_streams"] = sum(s.present_bytes or 0 for s in ctx.streams)
    sections.append(
        Section(
            4,
            "Corpus examined",
            "\n".join(f"- {key}: {value}" for key, value in corpus.items()),
            evidence=[{"kind": "session", "id": s.id} for s in ctx.sessions[:50]],
        )
    )

    endpoint_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for session in ctx.sessions:
        for endpoint in (session.client_endpoint, session.server_endpoint):
            if endpoint:
                endpoint_counts[endpoint] = endpoint_counts.get(endpoint, 0) + 1
    endpoint_lines = [f"- `{k}` in {v} session(s)" for k, v in sorted(endpoint_counts.items())]
    sections.append(
        Section(
            5,
            "TCP sessions observed",
            "\n".join(endpoint_lines) if endpoint_lines else "_No TCP sessions found._",
            evidence=[{"kind": "session", "id": s.id} for s in ctx.sessions[:100]],
        )
    )

    patterns = _pattern_findings(ctx)
    sections.append(
        Section(
            6,
            "Observed patterns",
            "\n".join(f"- {p}" for p in patterns) if patterns else "_Not enough data to state a pattern._",
            evidence=[],
            notes=["Each pattern above is a description of observed bytes, not a claim about meaning."],
        )
    )

    spec_sections = []
    spec_evidence = []
    for interpretation in ctx.interpretations:
        try:
            spec = parse_spec(interpretation.schema_json)
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
            spec_sections.append(f"- `{interpretation.name}` could not be parsed: {exc}")
            continue
        fields = ", ".join(f"{f.name}:{f.kind}@{f.offset}" for f in spec.fields)
        spec_sections.append(
            f"- **{interpretation.name}** (v{interpretation.version}, "
            f"checksum `{interpretation.checksum[:16]}`)\n"
            f"  - framing: `{spec.framing.method}`\n"
            f"  - fields: {fields or '_none_'}"
        )
        spec_evidence.append(
            {"kind": "interpretation", "id": interpretation.id, "version": interpretation.version}
        )
    sections.append(
        Section(
            7,
            "Proposed protocol structure",
            "\n".join(spec_sections) if spec_sections else "_No interpretation created yet._",
            evidence=spec_evidence,
            notes=["Field names are analyst labels unless marked otherwise in the specification."],
        )
    )

    run_lines = []
    run_evidence = []
    for run in ctx.runs:
        summary = run.summary or {}
        run_lines.append(
            f"- run `{run.id}` on {run.started_at.isoformat()}: "
            f"{summary.get('verdict', run.status)} - matched {summary.get('matched', 0)}, "
            f"failed {summary.get('failed', 0)} of {summary.get('total', 0)}"
            + ("  **(stale: rule changed afterwards)**" if run.stale else "")
        )
        run_evidence.append({"kind": "validation_run", "id": run.id})
    sections.append(
        Section(
            8,
            "Validated rules",
            "\n".join(run_lines) if run_lines else "_No validation run recorded._",
            evidence=run_evidence,
            notes=[
                "A rule that held across a corpus is supported by that corpus. It is not "
                "proven for data that has not been observed."
            ],
        )
    )

    if ctx.counterexamples:
        lines = []
        evidence = []
        for result in ctx.counterexamples[:50]:
            entries = (result.diagnostics or {}).get("entries", [])
            errors = [e for e in entries if e.get("severity") == "error"]
            lines.append(
                f"- message `{result.message_id}`: "
                + "; ".join(e.get("message", "") for e in errors)
            )
            evidence.append({"kind": "validation_result", "id": result.id, "message_id": result.message_id})
        section_body = "\n".join(lines)
    else:
        section_body = "_No counterexamples were recorded for the current rule versions._"
        evidence = []
    sections.append(
        Section(
            9,
            "Counterexamples",
            section_body,
            evidence=evidence,
            notes=[
                "A counterexample may be a wrong rule or an incomplete capture; both "
                "explanations are kept until one is ruled out."
            ],
        )
    )

    unknown = _unknown_regions(ctx)
    sections.append(Section(10, "Unresolved regions", unknown, evidence=[]))

    quality = _capture_quality(ctx)
    sections.append(Section(11, "Capture quality diagnostics", quality, evidence=[]))

    sections.append(Section(12, "Limitations", _limitations(ctx)))

    sections.append(Section(13, "Conclusions", _conclusions(ctx)))

    sections.append(Section(14, "Recommended next experiments", _recommendations(ctx)))

    sections.append(Section(15, "Reproduction instructions", _reproduction(ctx)))
    return sections


def _pattern_findings(ctx: ReportContext) -> list[str]:
    out: list[str] = []
    by_protocol: dict[str, int] = {}
    for stream in ctx.streams:
        by_protocol[stream.protocol_label] = by_protocol.get(stream.protocol_label, 0) + 1
    for protocol, count in sorted(by_protocol.items()):
        out.append(f"{count} stream(s) classified as `{protocol}`")
    lengths = [m.present_length or 0 for m in ctx.messages]
    if lengths:
        out.append(
            f"message lengths range from {min(lengths)} to {max(lengths)} bytes "
            f"({len(set(lengths))} distinct values over {len(lengths)} messages)"
        )
    conflicting = [s for s in ctx.streams if s.conflicts]
    if conflicting:
        out.append(f"{len(conflicting)} stream(s) contain byte conflicts at overlapping offsets")
    gapped = [s for s in ctx.streams if s.holes]
    if gapped:
        out.append(f"{len(gapped)} stream(s) contain gaps; some bytes were never captured")
    return out


def _unknown_regions(ctx: ReportContext) -> str:
    lines = []
    for interpretation in ctx.interpretations:
        try:
            spec = parse_spec(interpretation.schema_json)
        except Exception:
            continue
        unknown = [f.name for f in spec.fields if f.kind == "unknown" or f.semantic_status == "unknown"]
        if unknown:
            lines.append(f"- `{interpretation.name}` leaves {', '.join(unknown)} unexplained")
    if not lines:
        lines.append("- No explicitly unknown regions were declared in the current specifications.")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _capture_quality(ctx: ReportContext) -> str:
    lines = []
    incomplete = [s for s in ctx.sessions if s.completeness_status != "complete"]
    lines.append(f"- {len(incomplete)} of {len(ctx.sessions)} sessions were not fully captured")
    truncated = sum(1 for s in ctx.streams if (s.diagnostics or {}).get("is_truncated_start"))
    lines.append(f"- {truncated} stream(s) had no observed connection start")
    if ctx.integrity.get("all_match") is not None:
        lines.append(
            f"- source integrity: {'all files match their recorded hashes' if ctx.integrity['all_match'] else 'MISMATCH DETECTED'}"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _limitations(ctx: ReportContext) -> str:
    return "\n".join(
        [
            "- Conclusions cover only the captures listed above.",
            "- A reconstructed stream can be incomplete; gaps are shown, never filled.",
            "- Conflicting bytes at overlapping offsets were resolved by the recorded "
            "policy, and both variants remain recorded.",
            "- Field semantics are analyst hypotheses until a validation run supports them.",
            "- No claim here has been confirmed against the device documentation.",
        ]
    )


def _conclusions(ctx: ReportContext) -> str:
    supported = [
        h for h in ctx.hypotheses if h.status == "supported"
    ]
    contradicted = [h for h in ctx.hypotheses if h.status == "contradicted"]
    lines = []
    if supported:
        lines.append(
            f"- {len(supported)} hypothesis/hypotheses are supported by every message in "
            "the current corpus."
        )
    if contradicted:
        lines.append(f"- {len(contradicted)} hypothesis/hypotheses are contradicted by the corpus.")
    if ctx.counterexamples:
        lines.append(
            f"- {len(ctx.counterexamples)} message(s) contradict the current rules and remain unresolved."
        )
    if not lines:
        lines.append("- No hypothesis has been carried to a supported state yet.")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _recommendations(ctx: ReportContext) -> str:
    suggestions = [
        "- Capture a second recording of the same action sequence and validate the current rules against it.",
        "- Vary one parameter at a time so its field can be isolated by correlation.",
        "- Record a session that starts at connection establishment so the stream has no unknown prefix.",
        "- Investigate the counterexamples above before extending the rules further.",
    ]
    if not ctx.experiments:
        suggestions.insert(
            0,
            "- Import the experiment action log so messages can be tied to the action that produced them.",
        )
    return "\n".join(suggestions)


def _reproduction(ctx: ReportContext) -> str:
    steps = [
        "1. Import the .mplab project archive (or the individual PCAP files listed above).",
        "2. Re-run capture analysis with the recorded options.",
        "3. Import the interpretation specification(s) - the checksum is printed in section 7.",
        "4. Run validation against the same corpus; the verdict must match section 8.",
    ]
    options = ctx.captures[0].stats.get("options") if ctx.captures else None
    if options:
        steps.insert(2, f"   Analysis options used: `{json.dumps(options, sort_keys=True)}`")
    return "\n".join(steps)


def render_markdown(ctx: ReportContext, sections: list[Section], title: str) -> str:
    lines = [f"# {title}", "", f"_Generated by Madrigal Protocol Lab ({REPORT_VERSION}) on "
             f"{datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}_", ""]
    for section in sections:
        lines.append(f"## {section.number}. {section.title}")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(section.body)
        lines.append("")
        if section.evidence:
            refs = ", ".join(
                f"{e.get('kind')}:{e.get('id')}" for e in section.evidence[:15]
            )
            more = "" if len(section.evidence) <= 15 else f" (+{len(section.evidence) - 15} more)"
            lines.append(f"_Evidence: {refs}{more}_")
            lines.append("")
        for note in section.notes:
            lines.append(f"> {note}")
            lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def store_report(

"""Report endpoints."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Response
from sqlalchemy import select

from ...core.errors import NotFound
from ...core.logging import AuditEvent
from ...models import Report
from ...reporting.generator import (
    REPORT_VERSION,
    build_sections,
    collect_context,
    render_markdown,
    store_report,
)
from ...reporting.llm import LLMUnavailable, narrate
from ...schemas import ReportRequest
from ..context import SessionDep, StorageDep, audit, get_settings_dep, load_project

router = APIRouter()

SettingsDep = get_settings_dep


@router.post("/reports/generate")
def generate_report(
    payload: ReportRequest, session: SessionDep, storage: StorageDep, settings: SettingsDep
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    project = load_project(session, payload.title and payload.capture_ids and "" or "", session) if False else None  # placeholder
    return {}


@router.post("/projects/{project_id}/reports", response_model=dict)
def create_report(
    project_id: str, payload: ReportRequest, session: SessionDep, storage: StorageDep, settings: SettingsDep
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    project = load_project(session, project_id)
    ctx = collect_context(
        session,
        project,
        capture_ids=payload.capture_ids,
        interpretation_ids=payload.interpretation_ids,
        storage=storage,
        limits=settings.limits,
    )
    sections = build_sections(ctx)
    markdown = render_markdown(ctx, sections, payload.title)
    report = store_report(session, ctx, sections, markdown, payload.title)

    ai_used = False
    ai_warnings: list[str] = []
    if payload.use_llm:
        if not settings.allow_external_ai:
            ai_warnings.append(
                "External AI is disabled, so the report was produced entirely from "
                "stored facts. This is the expected offline behaviour."
            )
        else:
            try:
                result = narrate(
                    question="Summarise this protocol investigation for a reviewer.",
                    plan={"sections": [s.title for s in sections]},
                    result_summary=report.facts,
                    limits=settings.limits,
                    settings=settings,
                )
                report.ai_used = True
                report.ai_model = result["provider"]
                ai_warnings.append(result["disclaimer"])
            except LLMUnavailable as exc:
                ai_warnings.append(str(exc))
    report.ai_warnings = ai_warnings
    session.commit()

    audit(session).record(
        AuditEvent(
            "report.generate",
            project_id=project_id,
            object_type="report",
            object_id=report.id,
            details={"ai_used": report.ai_used, "sections": len(sections)},
        )
    )
    session.commit()
    return {
        "report_id": report.id,
        "title": report.title,
        "generator": REPORT_VERSION,
        "created_at": report.created_at,
        "sections": [s.to_dict() for s in sections],
        "facts": report.facts,
        "ai_used": report.ai_used,
        "ai_model": report.ai_model,
        "ai_warnings": ai_warnings,
    }


@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/reports")
def list_reports(project_id: str, session: SessionDep) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    load_project(session, project_id)
    rows = (
        session.execute(
            select(Report)
            .where(Report.project_id == project_id)
            .order_by(Report.created_at.desc())
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    return [
        {
            "id": r.id,
            "title": r.title,
            "generator": r.generator,
            "created_at": r.created_at,
            "ai_used": r.ai_used,
            "facts": r.facts,
        }
        for r in rows
    ]


@router.get("/reports/{report_id}")
def get_report(report_id: str, session: SessionDep) -> dict[str, Any]:
    report = session.get(Report, report_id)
    if report is None:
        raise NotFound(f"Report {report_id!r} does not exist.")
    return {
        "id": report.id,
        "project_id": report.project_id,
        "title": report.title,
        "generator": report.generator,
        "created_at": report.created_at,
        "sections": report.sections,
        "facts": report.facts,
        "ai_used": report.ai_used,
        "ai_model": report.ai_model,
        "ai_warnings": report.ai_warnings,
    }


@router.get("/reports/{report_id}/markdown")
def report_markdown(report_id: str, session: SessionDep) -> Response:
    report = session.get(Report, report_id)
    if report is None:
        raise NotFound(f"Report {report_id!r} does not exist.")
    return Response(

        media_type="text/markdown; charset=utf-8",

"""Background job endpoints.

Long-running analysis runs here.  Jobs are tracked in the database so progress,
cancellation and failures survive the request that started them.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, BackgroundTasks, Form, Query, UploadFile
from sqlalchemy import select

    from ..context import jobs

    return jobs(session, limits)

) -> list[dict]:
    from ...core.config import get_settings

    service = _job_service(session, get_settings().limits)
    return [
        {
            "id": job.id,
            "kind": job.kind,
            "status": job.status,
            "progress": job.progress,
            "stage": job.stage,
            "project_id": job.project_id,
            "created_at": job.created_at,
            "started_at": job.started_at,
            "finished_at": job.finished_at,
            "error_code": job.error_code,
            "error_message": job.error_message,
        }
        for job in service.list(project_id=project_id, limit=limit)
    ]


@router.get("/jobs/{job_id}")

@router.post("/captures/{capture_id}/analyze-async")
def analyze_async(
    capture_id: str,
    background: BackgroundTasks,
    session: SessionDep,
    storage: StorageDep,
    framing: Annotated[str | None, Form()] = None,
) -> dict:
    """Queue a capture analysis and run it in the background."""
    from ...core.config import get_settings

    settings = get_settings()
    capture = load_capture(session, capture_id)
    service = _job_service(session, settings.limits)
    job = service.create(
        "capture.analyze",
        project_id=capture.project_id,
        params={"capture_id": capture_id},
    )
    payload = AnalyzeRequest()
    if framing:
        import json

        try:
            payload = AnalyzeRequest(framing=json.loads(framing))
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ValidationFailed(f"The framing configuration is not valid: {exc}") from exc

    def run() -> None:
        from ...services.capture_analysis import AnalysisOptions, CaptureAnalyzer
        from ...services.jobs import run_analysis_job

        run_analysis_job(job.id, capture_id, payload, storage, settings)

    background.add_task(run)
    audit(session).record(
        AuditEvent(
            "job.start",
            project_id=capture.project_id,
            object_type="job",
            object_id=job.id,
            details={"kind": "capture.analyze", "capture_id": capture_id},
        )
    )
    session.commit()
    return {"job_id": job.id, "status": "queued"}

"""Long-running job bodies.

Kept separate from the routers so the same function backs both the synchronous
``/analyze`` endpoint and the queued ``/analyze-async`` endpoint, and so the
optional subprocess isolation in ``docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`` has one place to hook
in.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import traceback
from typing import Any

from ...core.errors import AppError, Canceled
from ...core.logging import AuditEvent, get_logger

log = get_logger("mplab.job")


def _session_factory(settings):
    from ...db.session import build_engine, make_session_factory

    return make_session_factory(build_engine(settings))


def run_analysis_job(
    job_id: str,
    capture_id: str,
    payload,
    storage,
    settings,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Execute one capture analysis as a tracked job.

    Every exit path records a status and removes temporary artefacts, so a
    cancelled or failed job never leaves debris behind.
    """
    from ...services.capture_analysis import AnalysisOptions, CaptureAnalyzer
    from ...services.project_service import JobService

    engine_session_factory = _session_factory(settings)
    session = engine_session_factory()
    service = JobService(session, settings.limits)
    audit = __import__(
        "app.services.project_service", fromlist=["AuditLog"]
    ).AuditLog(session)
    try:
        service.start(job_id)
        service.register_inflight(job_id)
        audit.record(
            AuditEvent(
                "job.start",
                object_type="job",
                object_id=job_id,
                details={"capture_id": capture_id},
            )
        )
        session.commit()
        capture = session.get(__import__("app.models", fromlist=["Capture"]).Capture, capture_id)
        if capture is None:
            raise AppError(f"Capture {capture_id!r} no longer exists.")
        capture.analysis_status = "running"
        session.commit()

        options = AnalysisOptions(
            flow_policy=payload.flow_policy,
            idle_timeout=payload.idle_timeout,
            conflict_policy=payload.conflict_policy,
            framing=payload.framing,
            detect_protocol=payload.detect_protocol,
            max_sessions=settings.limits.max_tcp_sessions_per_capture,
            max_messages_per_stream=settings.limits.max_messages_per_stream,
        )
        paths = storage.capture_paths(capture.project_id, capture.id, capture.format)

        def progress(fraction: float, stage: str) -> None:
            if service.is_cancelled(job_id):
                raise Canceled("The analysis was cancelled.")
            service.progress(job_id, fraction, stage)

        analyzer = CaptureAnalyzer(
            session, capture, paths.original, storage, options, settings.limits,
            progress=progress,
        )
        summary = analyzer.run()
        capture.analysis_status = "completed"
        capture.stats = summary
        session.commit()
        service.finish(job_id, status="succeeded", result=summary)
        audit.record(
            AuditEvent(
                "job.complete",
                project_id=capture.project_id,
                object_type="job",
                object_id=job_id,
                details={"capture_id": capture_id, "sessions": summary.get("sessions")},
            )
        )
        session.commit()
        return summary
    except Canceled:
        session.rollback()
        capture = session.get(__import__("app.models", fromlist=["Capture"]).Capture, capture_id)
        if capture is not None:
            capture.analysis_status = "canceled"
        session.commit()
        service.finish(job_id, status="canceled", error_code="canceled")
        audit.record(
            AuditEvent(
                "job.cancel",
                object_type="job",
                object_id=job_id,
                details={"capture_id": capture_id},
            )
        )
        session.commit()
        return {"status": "canceled"}
    except AppError as exc:
        session.rollback()
        _mark_failed(session, capture_id)
        service.finish(job_id, status="failed", error_code=exc.code, error_message=exc.message)
        audit.record(
            AuditEvent(
                "job.failed",
                object_type="job",
                object_id=job_id,
                outcome="failure",
                risk="error",
                details={"capture_id": capture_id, "code": exc.code},
            )
        )
        session.commit()
        raise
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
        session.rollback()
        _mark_failed(session, capture_id)
        log.exception("job %s failed", job_id)
        service.finish(
            job_id,
            status="failed",
            error_code="internal_error",
            error_message=type(exc).__name__,
        )
        audit.record(
            AuditEvent(
                "job.failed",
                object_type="job",
                object_id=job_id,
                outcome="failure",
                risk="error",
                details={"capture_id": capture_id},
            )
        )
        session.commit()
        traceback.clear_frames(sys_exc := None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        del sys_exc
        raise
    finally:
        service.cleanup(job_id)
        session.close()


def _mark_failed(session, capture_id: str) -> None:
    from ...models import Capture

    capture = session.get(Capture, capture_id)
    if capture is not None:
        capture.analysis_status = "failed"
    session.commit()

"""pcapng writer that carries per-packet comments.

Format notes (these matter, because naive claims here are wrong):

* Packet comments live in the **Packet Block option list** using option code 1
  (``comment``), value UTF-8 text.  That is the only place a comment is
  genuinely bound to an individual packet.
* Putting text in a Section Header Block or Interface Description Block
  describes the *file*, not a packet.  This writer uses an IDB comment to
  identify the export, and never claims it annotates a packet.
* Original timestamps and original packet bytes are copied unchanged.

The output is re-read by :mod:`app.analyzers.capture_reader` and by the
re-export verification step in :func:`export_annotated_pcapng`, so a broken
export fails loudly instead of producing a file nobody can open.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import struct
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import BinaryIO, Iterable

from ..core.errors import UnsupportedFormat

WRITER_VERSION = "pcapng-writer/1.1"

_SHB = 0x0A0D0D0A
_IDB = 0x00000001
_PB = 0x00000002  # obsolete Packet Block - carries comments
_EPB = 0x00000006

OPT_COMMENT = 1
OPT_ENDOFOPT = 0

LINKTYPE_ETHERNET = 1


def _option(code: int, value: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Encode a pcapng option with 32-bit alignment padding."""
    return struct.pack("<HH", code, len(value)) + value + b"\x00" * ((-len(value)) % 4)


def _options(items: Iterable[tuple[int, bytes]]) -> bytes:
    body = b"".join(_option(code, value) for code, value in items)
    return body + struct.pack("<HH", OPT_ENDOFOPT, 0)


def _block(block_type: int, body: bytes) -> bytes:
    padded = body + b"\x00" * ((-len(body)) % 4)
    total = len(padded) + 12
    return struct.pack("<II", block_type, total) + padded + struct.pack("<I", total)


@dataclass
class PacketRecord:
    timestamp: float
    data: bytes
    original_length: int
    comment: str | None = None


class PcapngWriter:
    """Minimal but spec-correct pcapng writer with per-packet comments."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        snaplen: int = 262144,
        linktype: int = LINKTYPE_ETHERNET,
        interface_comment: str = "",
        application: str = "Madrigal Protocol Lab",
    ) -> None:
        self.snaplen = snaplen
        self.linktype = linktype
        self.interface_comment = interface_comment
        self.application = application
        self._packets: list[PacketRecord] = []

    def add(self, record: PacketRecord) -> None:
        self._packets.append(record)

    def write(self, path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with path.open("wb") as handle:
            self._write_to(handle)
        return {"path": str(path), "packets": len(self._packets)}

    def _write_to(self, handle: BinaryIO) -> None:
        shb_options = [
            (OPT_COMMENT, (self.application + ": " + self.interface_comment).encode("utf-8")[:255])
        ]
        handle.write(
            _block(
                _SHB,
                struct.pack("<IHHq", 0x1A2B3C4D, 1, 0, -1) + _options(shb_options),
            )
        )
        handle.write(
            _block(
                _IDB,
                struct.pack("<HHI", self.linktype, 0, self.snaplen)
                + _options([(OPT_COMMENT, self.interface_comment.encode("utf-8")[:255])]),
            )
        )
        for record in self._packets:
            self._write_packet(handle, record)

    def _write_packet(self, handle: BinaryIO, record: PacketRecord) -> None:
        if record.comment:
            # The obsolete Packet Block is the only widely supported block that
            # takes options in the classic form; Enhanced Packet Blocks are used
            # where a reader can be expected to handle their option list.
            comment = record.comment.encode("utf-8")
            if len(comment) > 65535:
                comment = comment[:65535]
            body = (
                struct.pack(
                    "<HHIIII",
                    0,  # interface id
                    0,  # drops (obsolete field)
                    int(record.timestamp),
                    int((record.timestamp - int(record.timestamp)) * 1_000_000),
                    len(record.data),
                    record.original_length,
                )
                + record.data
                + b"\x00" * ((-len(record.data)) % 4)
                + _options([(OPT_COMMENT, comment)])
            )
            handle.write(_block(_PB, body))
            return
        units = int(round(record.timestamp * 1_000_000))
        body = (
            struct.pack("<IIIII", 0, units >> 32, units & 0xFFFFFFFF, len(record.data), record.original_length)
            + record.data
            + b"\x00" * ((-len(record.data)) % 4)
        )
        handle.write(_block(_EPB, body))


def read_comments(path: Path) -> dict[int, str]:
    """Re-read the exported file and return ``{packet_index: comment}``.

    Used by :func:`export_annotated_pcapng` to prove the annotations survived a
    round trip rather than merely having been written.
    """
    from ..analyzers.capture_reader import CaptureReader

    reader = CaptureReader(
        path, max_packets=5_000_000, max_packet_bytes=64 * 1024 * 1024
    )
    out: dict[int, str] = {}
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        reader.read_header(handle)
        for raw in reader.iter_packets():
            if raw.warnings:
                for warning in raw.warnings:
                    if warning.startswith("comment:"):
                        out[raw.index] = warning.split(":", 1)[1]
    return out


def verify_round_trip(source: Path, exported: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Compare packet counts, timestamps and bytes between two captures."""
    from ..analyzers.capture_reader import CaptureReader

    def collect(path: Path) -> list[tuple[float, int, bytes]]:
        reader = CaptureReader(path, max_packets=5_000_000, max_packet_bytes=64 * 1024 * 1024)
        rows: list[tuple[float, int, bytes]] = []
        with path.open("rb") as handle:
            reader.read_header(handle)
            for raw in reader.iter_packets():
                handle.seek(raw.data_offset)
                rows.append((raw.timestamp, raw.original_length, handle.read(raw.captured_length)))
        return rows

    try:
        original = collect(source)
        copy = collect(exported)
    except UnsupportedFormat as exc:
        return {"verified": False, "error": str(exc)}
    if len(original) != len(copy):
        return {
            "verified": False,
            "error": f"packet count changed: {len(original)} -> {len(copy)}",
        }
    mismatched = 0
    for index, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(original, copy)):
        if a[1] != b[1] or a[2] != b[2]:
            mismatched += 1
        elif abs(a[0] - b[0]) > 1e-3:
            mismatched += 1
    return {
        "verified": mismatched == 0,
        "packets": len(original),
        "mismatched_packets": mismatched,
        "note": (
            "Packet bytes, original lengths and timestamps are compared between the "
            "source capture and the exported file."
        ),
    }

"""Annotated pcapng export.

Guarantees, all of them verified before the endpoint reports success:

* the original capture is never modified;
* packet bytes, original lengths and timestamps are preserved;
* per-packet annotations are written as pcapng **packet block comments**, the
  only construct that genuinely binds text to an individual packet;
* the exported file is re-read to confirm the comments and the packets survived.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..analyzers.pcapng_writer import (
    PacketRecord,
    PcapngWriter,
    read_comments,
    verify_round_trip,
)
from ..analyzers.capture_reader import CaptureReader
from ..core.logging import AuditEvent, get_logger
from ..models import Annotation, Capture, Evidence, Hypothesis, Message, Packet
from ..services.storage import ProjectStorage

log = get_logger("mplab.pcapng")

MAX_COMMENT_CHARS = 400


def export_annotated_pcapng(
    capture: Capture, session: Session, storage: ProjectStorage
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    paths = storage.capture_paths(capture.project_id, capture.id, capture.format)
    source = paths.original
    if not source.exists():
        from ..core.errors import NotFound

        raise NotFound("The original capture file is missing from storage.")

    annotations = _packet_annotations(session, capture.id)
    hypotheses = _hypothesis_tags(session, capture.project_id)

    writer = PcapngWriter(
        interface_comment=(
            f"Madrigal Protocol Lab export of capture {capture.id} "
            f"({capture.name}); sha256 {capture.sha256}"
        )
    )
    written = 0
    reader = CaptureReader(
        source, max_packets=5_000_000, max_packet_bytes=64 * 1024 * 1024
    )
    with source.open("rb") as handle:
        reader.read_header(handle)
        for raw in reader.iter_packets():
            handle.seek(raw.data_offset)
            data = handle.read(raw.captured_length)
            comment = annotations.get(raw.index)
            if comment:
                comment = "; ".join(comment)[:MAX_COMMENT_CHARS]
            writer.add(
                PacketRecord(
                    timestamp=raw.timestamp,
                    data=data,
                    original_length=raw.original_length,
                    comment=comment,
                )
            )
            written += 1

    exports_dir = storage.exports_dir(capture.project_id, capture.id)
    target = exports_dir / "annotated.pcapng"
    writer.write(target)

    verification = verify_round_trip(source, target)
    comments = read_comments(target)
    expected = {i for i, notes in annotations.items() if notes}

    missing = sorted(expected - set(comments))
    result = {
        "capture_id": capture.id,
        "path": target.name,
        "packets_written": written,
        "packets_annotated": len(expected),
        "comments_verified": len(comments),
        "missing_comments": missing,
        "round_trip": verification,
        "hypothesis_tags": hypotheses,
        "success": bool(verification.get("verified")) and not missing,
        "notes": [
            "Annotations are stored as pcapng packet-block comments. The section and "
            "interface header comments identify the export itself and do not annotate "
            "individual packets.",
            "This file carries annotations only. It does not contain the project's "
            "hypotheses, validation history or reports; use the .mplab project export "
            "to transfer a full investigation.",
        ],
    }
    from ..services.project_service import AuditLog

    AuditLog(session).record(
        AuditEvent(
            "export.pcapng",
            project_id=capture.project_id,
            object_type="capture",
            object_id=capture.id,
            details={"packets": written, "annotated": len(expected), "verified": result["success"]},
        )
    )
    session.commit()
    return result


def _packet_annotations(session: Session, capture_id: str) -> dict[int, list[str]]:
    """Collect per-packet notes from messages, evidence and manual annotations."""
    out: dict[int, list[str]] = {}

    for message in (
        session.execute(select(Message).where(Message.capture_id == capture_id))
        .scalars()
        .all()
    ):
        label = (
            f"msg {message.index_in_stream} @stream+{message.start_offset} "
            f"len={message.present_length} framing={message.framing_method}"
        )
        for ref in message.packet_references or []:
            index = ref.get("packet_index")
            if isinstance(index, int):
                out.setdefault(index, []).append(label)

    for evidence in (
        session.execute(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.source_id == capture_id))
        .scalars()
        .all()
    ):
        label = f"evidence: {evidence.description or evidence.entity_type}"
        for index in evidence.packet_indexes or []:
            if isinstance(index, int):
                out.setdefault(index, []).append(label)

    for annotation in (
        session.execute(select(Annotation).where(Annotation.target_type == "packet"))
        .scalars()
        .all()
    ):
        if not annotation.target_id:
            continue
        try:
            index = int(annotation.target_id)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        out.setdefault(index, []).append(annotation.text[:200])

    return {k: v[:4] for k, v in out.items()}


def _hypothesis_tags(session: Session, project_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows = (
        session.execute(select(Hypothesis).where(Hypothesis.project_id == project_id))
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    return [
        {"id": h.id, "name": h.name, "status": h.status, "version": h.version}
        for h in rows[:100]
    ]


_ = (Path, Packet)

"""Portable investigation project archive (``.mplab``).

The archive is a ZIP with a manifest and a ``data/`` tree.  Design points that
matter:

* paths inside the archive are validated *before* extraction: absolute paths,
  ``..``, control characters, symlinks, duplicate names (including
  case/Unicode variants) and zip bombs are all rejected;
* extraction happens into a temporary directory and only becomes the live
  project after every hash in the manifest has been checked;
* a format version the build does not understand is refused rather than
  guessed at;
* nothing from the archive is executed, imported or dynamically loaded.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
import unicodedata
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
from typing import Any, Iterable

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..core.errors import Conflict, NotFound, SecurityViolation, UnsupportedFormat, ValidationFailed
from ..core.logging import AuditEvent, get_logger
from ..core.security import sha256_file, validate_relative_path
from ..models import (
    Annotation,
    Capture,
    Evidence,
    ExperimentEvent,
    FramingRule,
    Hypothesis,
    Interpretation,
    Project,
    Report,
    ValidationRun,
)
from .storage import ProjectStorage

log = get_logger("mplab.archive")

ARCHIVE_SUFFIX = ".mplab"
PROJECT_FORMAT_VERSION = 1
MANIFEST_NAME = "manifest.json"
MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024


@dataclass
class Manifest:
    format: str
    version: int
    project: dict[str, Any]
    files: list[dict[str, Any]]
    counts: dict[str, int]
    created_at: str
    generator: str = "madrigal-protocol-lab/0.1.0"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "format": self.format,
            "version": self.version,
            "generator": self.generator,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "project": self.project,
            "counts": self.counts,
            "files": self.files,
        }

def build_project_archive(
    *,
    project: Project,
    session: Session,
    storage: ProjectStorage,
    include_captures: bool = True,
    include_reports: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from ..services.project_service import AuditLog

    exports = storage.capture_paths(project.id, "archive", "pcap").export_dir
    storage.project_dir(project.id)
    exports.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = exports / f"{_slug(project.name)}{PROJECT_FORMAT_VERSION and ''}{ARCHIVE_SUFFIX}"

    project_dir = storage.project_dir(project.id)
    hypothesis_rows = list(
        session.execute(select(Hypothesis).where(Hypothesis.project_id == project.id))
        .scalars().all()
    )
    interpretation_rows = list(
        session.execute(select(Interpretation).where(Interpretation.project_id == project.id))
        .scalars().all()
    )
    experiment_rows = list(
        session.execute(select(ExperimentEvent).where(ExperimentEvent.project_id == project.id))
        .scalars().all()
    )
    validation_rows = list(
        session.execute(select(ValidationRun).where(ValidationRun.project_id == project.id))
        .scalars().all()
    )
    capture_rows = list(
        session.execute(select(Capture).where(Capture.project_id == project.id)).scalars().all()
    )
    report_rows = (
        list(session.execute(select(Report).where(Report.project_id == project.id)).scalars().all())
        if include_reports
        else []
    )

    research = {
        "hypotheses": [_hypothesis_payload(h) for h in hypothesis_rows],
        "interpretations": [_interpretation_payload(i) for i in interpretation_rows],
        "experiments": [
            {
                "timestamp": e.timestamp,
                "raw_timestamp": e.raw_timestamp,
                "action": e.action,
                "parameters": e.parameters,
                "observed_result": e.observed_result,
                "expected_result": e.expected_result,
                "metadata": e.metadata_json,
                "note": e.note,
            }
            for e in experiment_rows
        ],
        "validation_runs": [
            {
                "id": r.id,
                "interpretation_checksum": _checksum_for(session, r.interpretation_id),
                "corpus": r.corpus,
                "settings": r.settings,
                "started_at": r.started_at.isoformat(),
                "completed_at": r.completed_at.isoformat() if r.completed_at else None,
                "status": r.status,
                "summary": r.summary,
                "stale": r.stale,
                "analyzer_version": r.analyzer_version,
            }
            for r in validation_rows
        ],
        "captures": [
            {
                "id": c.id,
                "name": c.name,
                "sha256": c.sha256,
                "file_size": c.file_size,
                "format": c.format,
                "relative_path": c.relative_path,
                "imported_at": c.imported_at.isoformat(),
                "analysis_status": c.analysis_status,
                "stats": c.stats,
                "diagnostics": c.diagnostics,
            }
            for c in capture_rows
        ],
        "reports": [
            {"title": r.title, "markdown": r.markdown, "facts": r.facts, "created_at": r.created_at.isoformat()}
            for r in report_rows
        ],
        "framing_rules": [
            {"id": r.id, "name": r.name, "version": r.version, "method": r.method,
             "config": r.config, "notes": r.notes, "is_active": r.is_active}
            for r in session.execute(
                select(FramingRule).where(FramingRule.project_id == project.id)
            ).scalars().all()
        ],
        "annotations": [
            {"target_type": a.target_type, "target_id": a.target_id, "text": a.text,
             "tags": a.tags, "author": a.author}
            for a in session.execute(
                select(Annotation).where(Annotation.project_id == project.id)
            ).scalars().all()
        ],
        "evidence": [
            {"entity_type": e.entity_type, "entity_id": e.entity_id, "description": e.description,
             "confidence": e.confidence, "byte_ranges": e.byte_ranges}
            for e in session.execute(
                select(Evidence).where(Evidence.project_id == project.id)
            ).scalars().all()[:1000]
        ],
    }

    files: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as archive:
        research_blob = json.dumps(research, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode("utf-8")
        archive.writestr("data/research.json", research_blob)
        files.append({"path": "data/research.json", "sha256": _sha256_bytes(research_blob), "size": len(research_blob)})

        if include_captures:
            for capture in capture_rows:
                paths = storage.capture_paths(project.id, capture.id, capture.format)
                if not paths.original.exists():
                    files.append(
                        {
                            "path": capture.relative_path,
                            "missing": True,
                            "sha256": capture.sha256,
                            "size": 0,
                            "note": "source file absent; results referencing it cannot be reproduced",
                        }
                    )
                    continue
                archive_name = f"data/captures/{capture.id}/original.{capture.format}"
                blob = paths.original.read_bytes()
                archive.writestr(archive_name, blob)
                actual = _sha256_bytes(blob)
                files.append(
                    {
                        "path": archive_name,
                        "sha256": actual,
                        "expected_sha256": capture.sha256,
                        "size": len(blob),
                        "capture_id": capture.id,
                    }
                )

    manifest = Manifest(
        format="madrigal-protocol-lab-project",
        version=PROJECT_FORMAT_VERSION,
        project={
            "id": project.id,
            "name": project.name,
            "description": project.description,
            "schema_version": project.schema_version,
            "settings": project.settings,
            "created_at": project.created_at.isoformat(),
        },
        files=files,
        counts={
            "captures": len(capture_rows),
            "hypotheses": len(hypothesis_rows),
            "interpretations": len(interpretation_rows),
            "experiments": len(experiment_rows),
            "validation_runs": len(validation_rows),
            "reports": len(report_rows),
        },
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    )
    # The manifest is written last and is not self-referential.
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "a", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        archive.writestr(MANIFEST_NAME, json.dumps(manifest.to_dict(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

    size = target.stat().st_size
    AuditLog(session).record(
        AuditEvent(
            "project.export",
            project_id=project.id,
            object_type="project",
            object_id=project.id,
            details={"archive": target.name, "bytes": size, "files": len(files)},
        )
    )
    session.commit()
    return {
        "archive": target.name,
        "bytes": size,
        "files": len(files),
        "counts": manifest.counts,
        "format_version": PROJECT_FORMAT_VERSION,
    }


def _slug(name: str) -> str:
    import re

    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "-", name).strip("-.")
    return (cleaned or "project")[:60]


def _sha256_bytes(blob: bytes) -> str:
    import hashlib

    return hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()


def _hypothesis_payload(h: Hypothesis) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": h.id,
        "name": h.name,
        "description": h.description,
        "scope": h.scope,
        "proposed_structure": h.proposed_structure,
        "observations": h.observations,
        "evidence_refs": h.evidence_refs,
        "counterexample_refs": h.counterexample_refs,
        "unknown_regions": h.unknown_regions,
        "status": h.status,
        "version": h.version,
        "author": h.author,
        "origin": h.origin,
        "created_at": h.created_at.isoformat(),
        "updated_at": h.updated_at.isoformat(),
    }


def _interpretation_payload(i: Interpretation) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": i.id,
        "hypothesis_id": i.hypothesis_id,
        "name": i.name,
        "schema_json": i.schema_json,
        "version": i.version,
        "checksum": i.checksum,
        "notes": i.notes,
        "created_at": i.created_at.isoformat(),
    }


def _checksum_for(session: Session, interpretation_id: str) -> str | None:
    row = session.get(Interpretation, interpretation_id)
    return row.checksum if row else None

def inspect_archive(path: Path, limits) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate an archive *without* extracting it.

    Every check here happens against the zip directory, so a hostile archive is
    rejected before a single byte is written to disk.
    """
    problems: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        infos = archive.infolist()
        if len(infos) > limits.max_archive_entries:
            raise SecurityViolation(
                "The archive contains more entries than this deployment accepts.",
                details={"entries": len(infos), "limit": limits.max_archive_entries},
            )
        total_uncompressed = 0
        seen: dict[str, str] = {}
        for info in infos:
            name = info.filename
            if info.is_dir():
                continue
            # Symlink: unix mode bits in the top 16 of external_attr.
            mode = (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0xF000
            if mode == 0xA000:
                problems.append({"path": name, "problem": "symlink entries are not permitted"})
                continue
            try:
                validate_relative_path(name)
            except SecurityViolation as exc:
                problems.append({"path": name[:120], "problem": str(exc)})
                continue
            folded = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", name).casefold()
            if folded in seen and seen[folded] != name:
                problems.append(
                    {
                        "path": name[:120],
                        "problem": (
                            f"duplicate entry; {seen[folded][:60]} differs only by case or "
                            "Unicode normalisation"
                        ),
                    }
                )
            seen[folded] = name
            if info.file_size > limits.max_archive_entry_bytes:
                problems.append({"path": name[:120], "problem": "entry exceeds the per-file limit"})
            total_uncompressed += info.file_size
            if info.compress_size > 0:
                ratio = info.file_size / info.compress_size
                if ratio > limits.max_archive_compression_ratio:
                    problems.append(
                        {
                            "path": name[:120],
                            "problem": (
                                f"compression ratio {ratio:.0f}:1 exceeds the limit of "
                                f"{limits.max_archive_compression_ratio}:1"
                            ),
                        }
                    )
            if name.count("/") > limits.max_archive_depth:
                problems.append({"path": name[:120], "problem": "entry nests too deeply"})
        if total_uncompressed > limits.max_archive_uncompressed_bytes:
            problems.append(
                {
                    "path": "<archive>",
                    "problem": (
                        "total uncompressed size exceeds the limit "
                        f"({total_uncompressed} > {limits.max_archive_uncompressed_bytes} bytes)"
                    ),
                }
            )

        try:
            manifest_raw = archive.read(MANIFEST_NAME)
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise UnsupportedFormat(
                "The archive has no manifest.json, so it is not a Madrigal project archive."
            ) from exc
        if len(manifest_raw) > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
            raise UnsupportedFormat("The manifest is implausibly large and was not parsed.")
        try:
            manifest = json.loads(manifest_raw.decode("utf-8"))
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
            raise UnsupportedFormat(f"The manifest is not readable: {exc}") from exc

        if manifest.get("format") != "madrigal-protocol-lab-project":
            raise UnsupportedFormat(
                f"Unrecognised archive format {manifest.get('format')!r}."
            )
        version = manifest.get("version")
        if not isinstance(version, int):
            raise UnsupportedFormat("The manifest does not declare an integer format version.")
        if version > PROJECT_FORMAT_VERSION:
            raise UnsupportedFormat(
                f"This archive uses project format version {version}, but this build "
                f"understands up to {PROJECT_FORMAT_VERSION}. Refusing to guess at a "
                "newer format."
            )
    return {
        "valid": not problems,
        "problems": problems,
        "entries": len(infos),
        "uncompressed_bytes": total_uncompressed,
        "manifest_version": version,
        "manifest": manifest,
    }


def import_project_archive(
    path: Path, session: Session, storage: ProjectStorage, limits, *, name_override: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Import an archive as a new project.

    Extraction lands in a temporary directory first; the live project is only
    created after every manifest hash has been verified.
    """
    inspection = inspect_archive(path, limits)
    if not inspection["valid"]:
        raise SecurityViolation(
            "The archive failed validation and was not extracted.",
            details={"problems": inspection["problems"][:20]},
        )
    manifest = inspection["manifest"]

    staging = Path(os.path.join(str(storage.root), f".import-{os.urandom(8).hex()}"))
    staging.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
            for info in archive.infolist():
                if info.is_dir():
                    continue
                safe = validate_relative_path(info.filename)
                destination = staging / PurePosixPath(*safe.parts)
                destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with archive.open(info) as source_handle, destination.open("wb") as target_handle:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(source_handle, target_handle, length=1024 * 1024)
                if destination.stat().st_size > limits.max_archive_entry_bytes:
                    raise SecurityViolation(
                        "An extracted entry exceeded the per-file limit.", details={"path": safe.name}
                    )

        mismatches = _verify_hashes(staging, manifest.get("files", []))
        research_path = staging / "data" / "research.json"
        if not research_path.exists():
            raise UnsupportedFormat("The archive does not contain data/research.json.")
        research = json.loads(research_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

        project_name = name_override or (manifest.get("project") or {}).get("name") or "Imported project"
        from ..services.project_service import ProjectService

        service = ProjectService(session, storage, limits)
        project = service.create(
            name=project_name,
            description=(manifest.get("project") or {}).get("description", ""),
            settings=(manifest.get("project") or {}).get("settings", {}),
        )
        _restore_captures(session, storage, project, research, staging, limits)
        _restore_research(session, project, research)

        AuditLog = __import__("app.services.project_service", fromlist=["AuditLog"]).AuditLog
        AuditLog(session).record(
            AuditEvent(
                "project.import",
                project_id=project.id,
                object_type="project",
                object_id=project.id,
                details={
                    "archive": path.name,
                    "hash_mismatches": len(mismatches),
                    "counts": manifest.get("counts", {}),
                },
            )
        )
        session.commit()
        return {
            "project_id": project.id,
            "name": project.name,
            "imported": {
                "captures": len(research.get("captures", [])),
                "hypotheses": len(research.get("hypotheses", [])),
                "interpretations": len(research.get("interpretations", [])),
                "experiments": len(research.get("experiments", [])),
                "validation_runs": len(research.get("validation_runs", [])),
            },
            "hash_mismatches": mismatches,
            "notes": [
                "Reconstructed streams are not stored in the archive; re-run capture "
                "analysis to reproduce them. Deterministic re-analysis is part of the "
                "project's reproducibility guarantee.",
                (
                    "One or more capture files did not match their recorded hashes and "
                    "were not imported."
                    if mismatches
                    else "All capture hashes matched the manifest."
                ),
            ],
        }
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)


def _verify_hashes(staging: Path, files: Iterable[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    mismatches: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for entry in files:
        if entry.get("missing"):
            mismatches.append({"path": entry.get("path"), "problem": "source file was absent at export time"})
            continue
        expected = entry.get("sha256")
        target = staging / PurePosixPath(*validate_relative_path(entry["path"]).parts)
        if not target.exists():
            mismatches.append({"path": entry.get("path"), "problem": "file listed in the manifest is missing"})
            continue
        actual = sha256_file(target)
        expected_source = entry.get("expected_sha256")
        problems = []
        if expected and actual != expected:
            problems.append("archive hash mismatch")
        if expected_source and actual != expected_source:
            problems.append("source capture hash mismatch")
        if problems:
            mismatches.append(
                {"path": entry.get("path"), "problem": "; ".join(problems), "actual": actual}
            )
    return mismatches


def _restore_captures(
    session: Session,
    storage: ProjectStorage,
    project: Project,
    research: dict[str, Any],
    staging: Path,
    limits,
) -> None:
    mismatched = {
        entry.get("path")
        for entry in research.get("captures", [])
        if entry.get("sha256") and _file_hash(staging, project, entry) not in (None, entry["sha256"])
    }
    for entry in research.get("captures", []):
        staged = staging / "data" / "captures" / entry["id"] / f"original.{entry['format']}"
        if not staged.exists() or entry["id"] in mismatched:
            continue
        try:
            capture = _import_capture_row(session, storage, project, entry, staged, limits)
        except (Conflict, ValidationFailed, NotFound):
            continue


def _file_hash(staging: Path, project: Project, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
    staged = staging / "data" / "captures" / entry["id"] / f"original.{entry['format']}"
    return sha256_file(staged) if staged.exists() else None


def _import_capture_row(
    session: Session, storage: ProjectStorage, project: Project, entry: dict[str, Any], staged: Path, limits
) -> Capture:
    from ..services.project_service import ProjectService

    service = ProjectService(session, storage, limits)
    capture = service.import_capture(
        project,
        name=entry["name"],
        source=staged,
        declared_format=entry["format"],
        source_kind="project_import",
    )
    capture.analysis_status = "pending"
    capture.stats = entry.get("stats", {})
    capture.diagnostics = entry.get("diagnostics", {})
    session.commit()
    return capture


def _restore_research(session: Session, project: Project, research: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    for payload in research.get("hypotheses", []):
        session.add(
            Hypothesis(
                project_id=project.id,
                name=payload.get("name", "Hypothesis")[:200],
                description=payload.get("description", ""),
                scope=payload.get("scope", {}),
                proposed_structure=payload.get("proposed_structure", {}),
                observations=payload.get("observations", []),
                evidence_refs=payload.get("evidence_refs", []),
                counterexample_refs=payload.get("counterexample_refs", []),
                unknown_regions=payload.get("unknown_regions", []),
                status=payload.get("status", "draft"),
                version=int(payload.get("version", 1)),
                author=payload.get("author", "analyst")[:120],
                origin=payload.get("origin", "analyst")[:32],
            )
        )
    for payload in research.get("interpretations", []):
        session.add(
            Interpretation(
                project_id=project.id,
                name=payload.get("name", "Interpretation")[:200],
                schema_json=payload.get("schema_json", {}),
                version=int(payload.get("version", 1)),
                checksum=payload.get("checksum", ""),
                notes=payload.get("notes", ""),
            )
        )
    for payload in research.get("experiments", []):
        session.add(
            ExperimentEvent(
                project_id=project.id,
                timestamp=float(payload.get("timestamp", 0.0)),
                raw_timestamp=payload.get("raw_timestamp"),
                action=str(payload.get("action", ""))[:120],
                parameters=payload.get("parameters", {}),
                observed_result=payload.get("observed_result"),
                expected_result=payload.get("expected_result"),
                metadata_json=payload.get("metadata", {}),
                note=payload.get("note", ""),
            )
        )
    for payload in research.get("validation_runs", []):
        session.add(
            ValidationRun(

CHUNK = 1024 * 1024


@router.get("/security/report")
def security_report(request, settings: SettingsDep) -> dict[str, Any]:
    engine = request.app.state.engine
    return runtime_report(
        settings, engine=engine, llm_status=llm_status(settings), sklearn=sklearn_available()
    )

def security_check(request, session: SessionDep, settings: SettingsDep) -> dict[str, Any]:

    report = runtime_report(
        settings, engine=engine, llm_status=llm_status(settings), sklearn=sklearn_available()
    )

                "summary": report["security_checks"]["summary"],
            },
        )
    )
    session.commit()
    return report


@router.post("/security/inspect-archive")
async def inspect_archive_upload(
    settings: SettingsDep, file: Annotated[UploadFile, File()]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate an uploaded ``.mplab`` archive without extracting it."""
    display = safe_display_filename(file.filename)
    if not display.lower().endswith(".mplab"):
        from ...core.errors import UnsupportedFormat

        raise UnsupportedFormat(
            "A Madrigal project archive must have the .mplab extension.",
            details={"received_extension": Path(display).suffix},
        )
    temp_path: Path | None = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".mplab") as handle:
            temp_path = Path(handle.name)
            written = 0
            while True:
                chunk = await file.read(CHUNK)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                written += len(chunk)
                if written > settings.limits.max_project_total_bytes:
                    raise PayloadTooLarge(
                        "The archive exceeds the maximum project size accepted by this "
                        "deployment.",
                        details={"limit_bytes": settings.limits.max_project_total_bytes},
                    )
                handle.write(chunk)
        result = inspect_archive(temp_path, settings.limits)
        result.pop("manifest", None)
        result["note"] = (
            "The archive was validated without being extracted. Import it to create a "
            "project."
        )
        return result
    finally:
        if temp_path is not None and temp_path.exists():
            temp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)


@router.post("/projects/import")
async def import_project(
    session: SessionDep,
    storage: StorageDep,
    settings: SettingsDep,
    file: Annotated[UploadFile, File()],
    name: Annotated[str | None, Form()] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Import a ``.mplab`` archive as a new, independent project."""
    display = safe_display_filename(file.filename)
    if not display.lower().endswith(".mplab"):
        from ...core.errors import UnsupportedFormat

        raise UnsupportedFormat(
            "A Madrigal project archive must have the .mplab extension.",
            details={"received_extension": Path(display).suffix},
        )
    temp_path: Path | None = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".mplab") as handle:
            temp_path = Path(handle.name)
            written = 0
            while True:
                chunk = await file.read(CHUNK)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                written += len(chunk)
                if written > settings.limits.max_project_total_bytes:
                    raise PayloadTooLarge(
                        "The archive exceeds the maximum project size accepted by this "
                        "deployment.",
                        details={"limit_bytes": settings.limits.max_project_total_bytes},
                    )
                handle.write(chunk)
        if written == 0:
            from ...core.errors import ValidationFailed

            raise ValidationFailed("The uploaded archive is empty.")

        inspection = inspect_archive(temp_path, settings.limits)
        audit(session).record(
            AuditEvent(
                "security.denied"
                if not inspection["valid"]
                else "project.import",
                object_type="archive",
                object_id=display[:120],
                outcome="failure" if not inspection["valid"] else "success",
                risk="warning",
                details={
                    "bytes": written,
                    "entries": inspection["entries"],
                    "valid": inspection["valid"],
                    "problem_count": len(inspection["problems"]),
                },
            )
        )
        session.commit()
        if not inspection["valid"]:
            raise SecurityViolation(
                "The archive failed validation and was not extracted.",
                details={"problems": inspection["problems"][:20]},
            )
        return import_project_archive(
            temp_path, session, storage, settings.limits, name_override=name
        )
    finally:
        if temp_path is not None and temp_path.exists():
            temp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
